name: Docker Studio
description: A graphical client for the Docker engine: a live dashboard of resource use and what needs attention, containers grouped by Compose stack with their logs, files, stats and a shell, images with their layers and a run form, volumes, networks, stacks with their service map, builds with their steps, and AI that diagnoses failures and writes Dockerfiles. Every operation runs the docker program without a shell.

commands.title: Docker Studio: open
commands.description: Open Docker Studio, on a section when one is named.

commands.title: Docker Studio: refresh
commands.description: Read the engine and every list again.

endue.docker-studio.path.description: The PATH docker is looked up on and runs with (folders separated by :), for a desk started without the shell's PATH. Empty: the desk's PATH, then where docker is usually installed.

endue.docker-studio.stop-timeout.description: Seconds a stop or restart waits before docker kills the container (0 to 600).

endue.docker-studio.log-tail.description: How many of the last log lines open with the logs (0 to 100000).

endue.docker-studio.log-max.description: How many log lines a log view keeps while following (100 to 100000).

endue.docker-studio.shell.description: The shell a terminal or the Exec tab starts in a container: a path or name inside it, like /bin/bash.

endue.docker-studio.confirm.description: Ask before removing, killing, taking down or pruning.
